firstPlayerRule: There is no first player: everyone chooses a card face down at the same time. After the reveal, the player who played the lowest card places it first, then the next lowest, and so on.
clarifications: This reveal-and-place step repeats ten times per round, so placement order is set anew by card values every turn.
Cards are only revealed once every player has put a card face down.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the English rules from AMIGO's rules server (https://blog.amigo-spiele.de/content/ap/rule/02401-GB-AmigoRule.pdf), SHA-256 062b65e6e45874697efd6b23545dd655c75d91d94a3ffc312aed4553933f7488, and extracted the text of all 28 pages. PDF page 4 (printed 4), Playing the Game: each player picks a card and puts it face down; cards are revealed after all players have cards in front of them; the player who played the lowest card goes first and places it, then the second-lowest, until the highest. The cover credits Wolfgang Kramer; the text describes the 104-card bull-head game and calls itself the 30th Anniversary edition, matching BGG 432. Last page: AMIGO Spiel + Freizeit GmbH, 2024, Version 1.0. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25.
